title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・緊急コード

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun loses to Narita Brian, but realizes there is something else Narita Brian is searching for—something separate from the results of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curious to discover what it is Narita Brian desires, Mayano Top Gun wants to race against her again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when she hears from Hishi Amazon that Narita Brian is not planning on racing again after the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vowing to become a racer capable of exciting even Narita Brian, she sets her sights on the G1 race in which the best racers compete—the Takarazuka Kinen.
